scope.exposure: Entire passages and the local adjacent pair were previously inspected. Informed construction, not a preregistered target test.

operator.name: Reserve
operator.argument: One already identified resource x satisfying unchanged unknown whole-description N_X(x); no group lift, member count, calibrated amount or identified material.
operator.state: Available/committed status of that same resource within the represented plan. No claim a physical action already happened.
operator.R: A distinct commitment at each construction occurrence requires x available and makes x committed. A second distinct commitment of that same x without release is invalid.
operator.I_rival: EnsureCommitted(x) repeats one reservation proposition/use: it is idempotent and a second assertion may refer to the SAME commitment. R instead stipulates DISTINCT commitments at different construction occurrences. This event-identity difference is an explicit extra assumption, not settled by the repeated spelling.
operator.binding: Retain all five Q2 source-anchor choices only as hypotheses; different names/variables do not establish different resources. Never mint fresh resource identity to hide reuse.
operator.mention: Only a nominal-descriptor or source-anchor lookup explicitly modeled as part of Reserve is side-effect-free: the lookup itself neither releases, refills nor clones a resource. The115 other unread groups are not turned into no-ops by calling them ordinary mentions. Their state effect is unknown.
operator.unknown_text: Keep all115 other source groups and four other marker relations uninterpreted. Nonempty intervening text or boundary/drawing interrupts executable state propagation; it may contain a state change, but none is supplied. Therefore no complete end inventory and no global claim of absent release.
operator.no_hidden_transition: For the direct four-group span oiiin daiin qokeey daiin, descriptor lookups are pure and no extra state transition is inserted between its two Reserve events. This is a local construction contract, not proof that natural language cannot imply an unwritten transition.
operator.same_descriptor: Repeated description is not repeated resource identity; alias decisions are inputs, never chosen by event position or word spelling.

selected_consequence.limits: No native identity/availability binding selects either outcome or operator. Seven other within-document consecutive pairs have unread intervening material if verified; do not manufacture further inequalities.

decision_note.unknown: Whether a repeated construction encodes a distinct exclusive commitment or merely a reusable assertion, and whether the adjacent inputs identify the same resource. Unlike count, this question can be stated without native member cardinality.
decision_note.different_input: Existing132group construction plus direct two-event span supplies a concrete local state contrast absent from the prior generic80/124 proposal. It does not supply physical state or semantic confirmation.
decision_note.smallest_work: One ten-construction annotated passage, explicit R/I operator and same/different scenario calculations, full source preservation, word-account review and independent narrow validator. No corpus scan, decoder, new GDT, image or final-inventory experiment.
decision_note.decision_by_outcome: If the operator yields a clear content dependency under fixed assumptions, retain it as an unselected conditional reading with exact unresolved bindings. If it needs hidden release, identity fabrication or silent opaque-text no-ops, do not call the trace executable. Both outcomes leave lexical preference open.
decision_note.budget: 55minutes total from21:08UTC, including preceding retrieval, authoring, independent validation and publication; no automatic extension or decoder work.

assumptions: Each modeled R occurrence is a distinct use commitment, not a restatement of the same use.
Resource identity is fixed independently of occurrence labels; whole-resource exclusivity, no implicit portion division.
Local nominal description lookup is side-effect-free.
No silent release/replenishment inside the chosen adjacent construction span.
Initial availability and noun meanings remain unknown.
No inferred state persistence through unread intervening text.
Finite free/bound construction licenses remain hypotheses, reader alternatives unpooled.
